meta.notes: Take 5 with the owner's three notes fixed. (1) The shove no longer opens on the take's own dissolve: rigg5-shove-t1 cross-dissolves between two framings from 0.83 to 1.08 s, and Take 5 cut in at 0.7, so the dissolve played at 5.51-5.76 s as he hit the door. It now cuts straight from the 00:30 device on the action, at 1.125 s, his arm already swinging into the door; both thuds (1.35 and 2.10 s in the take) stay, and the shot is 0.425 s shorter. (2) The crowbar insert is regenerated as rigg6-pry-t3, started from a still of the set's own door (a crop of Take 5's approved shove frame, rigg5/shove-end.png, with the crowbar and his hands added by a Gemini image edit): the door stays shut and flush the whole shot (its seam measured at x = 425-427 px in every frame, never lit), the bar strains and its tip skids out of the seam with a clang at 3.2 s, leaving a gouge. Its sound is lifted to 1.25 to sit at Take 5's crowbar level (-30.2 against -30.1 LUFS). (3) No look to camera: the stare shot (he turns to the camera from 1.4 s of rigg5-stare-t1) is gone. The cut ends on her: her shot runs 0.96 s past "It's a pull." with her eyes on him, freezes for 1.7 s, and the theme sting starts 0.15 s before the freeze, as it did in Take 5. Everything else is Take 5 unchanged, 0.425 s earlier from the shove on. The performances are new: they mark Rigg's two setup-and-payoff pairs and her line for mdmedia cut check; each pair is one generation.

performances.intent: a setup and its payoff: the missing tool, then the improvised one
performances.delivery: focused, then quick and dry: one train of thought, no change of voice between the two lines

performances.intent: a setup and its payoff: the last option
performances.delivery: through gritted teeth, low, then grim and determined; the same sweating, desperate man in one breath of time
flat and dry, deadpan and unimpressed: a beat after "Rigg.", then "It's a pull." as a plain statement, never shouted

take:rigg6-pry-t3.notes: First frame: rigg5/shove-end.png cropped to the door seam (rigg6/stills/seam-crop.png), with the crowbar and two hands added by a Gemini image edit (rigg6/stills/pry-insert-a.png), scaled to 1280x720. Takes t1 (rigg6-pry-a) and t2 (rigg6-pry-b) also kept the door shut; t1's clang comes 0.4 s before the bar slips, t2's bar never bends and its seam drifts 3 px as it strains.
